{{Quote|Just came up to check on us, Scythe? Well, we are on course, and all systems are green.|The clone trooper pilot to Scythe|<ref name="Brain Invaders" />}}
A '''clone trooper pilot''' was stationed aboard the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|Pelta-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with another [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during a [[Skirmish aboard TB-73/Legends|skirmish ]]aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What the- ?|The clone trooper pilot to Scythe, Edge and Ox|<ref name="Brain Invaders" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> shortly after the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were sent on a mission to receive medical supplies from the [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|Ord Cestus medical station]] and then rendezvous with a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] carrying [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to provide aid to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] after a [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|battle]] that had taken place there.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

Padawans Tano and Offee, accompanied by members of [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]], took the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|Pelta-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']], which was flown by this [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] and another one, on the assignment. However, clone trooper [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] was infected by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] and subsequently put brain worm eggs in his [[backpack]], taking them aboard the medical frigate. After the journey to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] had begun, Padawan Tano was trying to sleep, but couldn't, so she and Padawan Offee went to the mess hall of the frigate to eat. At the same time, Scythe placed brain worm eggs in the quarters in which other clones were sleeping and they were infected. As the Jedi ate in the mess hall, Scythe, [[Edge/Legends|Edge]] and [[Ox/Legends|Ox]] went to the bridge where this clone trooper pilot and another were [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the ship. The pilot asked Scythe whether he had come to check up on them and told him that the frigate was on course and all systems were operational before Edge and Ox raised their DC-15 blasters at the bridge crew. Hearing the blasters move, the clone trooper pilot turned towards Scythe, Edge and Ox, surprised, and wanted to ask what was happening. Ox and Edge then shot the pilots.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

After [[Death|killing]] the pilots, Edge and Ox went to the mess hall to attack the two Jedi, and were knocked out by them before [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Trap/Legends|Trap]] and [[Havoc (clone trooper)/Legends|Havoc]] arrived. When the Padawans raised their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] at the other two clones, they surrendered and pretended not to have been infected by brain worms. Trap told [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] Tano and Offee that they should make sure that they were still in control of the bridge. Offee attempted to contact the bridge, but received no response as the pilots had been killed and the bridge had been taken over by brain-worm-infected clone troopers. The two Jedi and Trap went to the bridge while Havoc pretended to guard the unconscious Edge and Ox. This clone trooper pilot was dragged away from the bridge by Edge and the other by Pulsar as Scythe told another trooper to engage the autopilot and to activate the security shields, the latter of which prevented the Padawans from reaching the bridge.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

As Padawan Offee attempted to override the security shields, Trap pointed his blaster at her and began firing, revealing he had also been infected by a brain worm. The Jedi killed the lieutenant and the brain worm that had infected him in self-defense and proceeded to a cargo hold where they encountered other clones and fought against them. After they escaped in the ventilation system, they split up, Commander Tano going to contact Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Fisto]] and Commander Offee going to the bridge. As the former informed General Fisto of the situation and spoke with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and then with General Skywalker, who told her that the brain worms were affected by the cold, Offee had also been infected. She found Tano and attacked her, but the latter escaped and ruptured the cooling system of the vessel.<ref name="Brain Invaders" /> 

After Padawan Tano reached the bridge, Offee attacked her again. The former prevailed and [[Republic tugboat/Legends|Republic tugboats]] guided ''TB-73'' to dock at the Ord Cestus Medical station as the brain worms died from the [[Temperature/Legends|cold]]. After the skirmish, Tano and Offee were taken to the Ord Cestus Medical Station.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Personality and traits==
The clone trooper pilot had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Databank" /> They were friendly and trusted their fellow clones, being surprised when Edge and Ox raised their blasters towards them and the other pilot.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper pilot appeared in the eighth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, titled "[[Brain Invaders]]." Like all other clones in the series, they were voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
